## Open .gpkg files

```{r}
# Install and load the sf package
#install.packages("sf")
library(sf)

# Define the path to your .gpkg file
file_path <- "974/Vector_Data/20230606_cbblackburn3_p1.gpkg"

# Read the GeoPackage file
gpkg_data <- st_read(file_path)

# Explore the data
summary(gpkg_data)
head(gpkg_data)
str(gpkg_data)

# Plot the data
plot(gpkg_data)

```
